title: Pop-up Panic: Windows 95 Edition (v3)
description: Close relentless Win95 pop-ups before they crash your desktop — now with a devilish boss popup that dodges your cursor!
prompt: for each game after a random amount of closed windows around 20 spawn a boss popup that moves when you try to close it. dont make it impossible but make it hard to click on the x. Make the window red with a laughing devil face.
